import os
import psycopg

dsn = os.environ.get("APP_DB_URL", "").strip()
assert dsn, "APP_DB_URL missing"
conn = psycopg.connect(dsn)
conn.autocommit = True
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute('ALTER TABLE actimize_screening_type_mappings RENAME COLUMN screening_type_name TO "Screening_Type"')
cur.execute("SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='actimize_screening_type_mappings' ORDER BY ordinal_position")
cols = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
print('RENAME_COLUMN_OK columns=' + ','.join(cols))

cur.close()
conn.close()
